concept.title: Modem / ONT
concept.shortdesc: A modem or Optical Network Terminal (ONT) connects a home network to the Internet service provided by the Internet Service Provider (ISP). It serves as the entry point for Internet connectivity.

section.title: Overview
section.p: A or ONT receives the Internet connection from the ISP and forwards the connection to the .

section.title: What is a Modem?
section.p: A modem is a networking device that receives Internet service from an ISP and converts the incoming signal into a format that network devices can use.
Modems are commonly used with cable, DSL, and broadband Internet services.

section.title: What is an ONT?
section.p: An Optical Network Terminal (ONT) performs a similar function to a modem but is used with fiber-optic Internet services.
The ONT converts optical signals received through a fiber-optic connection into network signals that can be used by the .

section.title: Role of the Modem or ONT
section.p: The modem or ONT acts as the gateway between the ISP network and the home network.
Without a modem or ONT, the cannot access Internet services.
All Internet traffic passes through the modem or ONT before it reaches the router and connected devices.
